draft:
**Environmental Commitments**

Amaris takes a measurable approach to sustainability. Between 2022 and 2024, we achieved a 28% reduction in combined Scope 1 and 2 emissions — driven by office energy efficiency upgrades and a revised business travel policy that caps non-essential flights to 2 per consultant per year. These are not aspirational targets; they are verified outcomes from our annual carbon accounting process.

**Social Impact**

In 2024, we ran a structured 6-month apprenticeship programme that placed 180 junior consultants from underrepresented backgrounds into client-facing roles. We view talent diversity as both an ethical obligation and a business advantage that brings broader perspective to client engagements.

**Alignment with Your Programme**

We will work with your sustainability team to ensure this programme's carbon footprint is tracked from initiation, and that any digital waste generated (storage, compute) is offset through our carbon-neutral cloud provisioning commitments.
